name: Giant Octopus
otherStatistics: Perception +4. Stealth +5. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 14. No languages.
appearance: A large ivory octopus with a rounded mantle, eight arms, and pale pink suckers.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast D&D Adventurers League, Cole Kronewitter, The Waydown, November 1, 2015 release, Appendix: Monster/NPC Statistics, printed and p. 30. https://www.dmsguild.com/product/170504/DDEX309-The-Waydown-5e
sections.Traits:
Hold Breath. The octopus can hold its breath for 1 hour outside water.

Underwater Camouflage. The octopus has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks while underwater.

Water Breathing. The octopus can breathe only underwater.
sections.Actions:
Tentacles. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. A hit deals 10 (2d6 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 16). It remains restrained while that grapple lasts, and the octopus cannot use its tentacles on a different target until the grapple ends.

Ink Cloud (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest). While underwater, the octopus releases a 20-ft.-radius cloud around itself. The cloud heavily obscures the area for 1 minute unless a significant current disperses it earlier. After releasing the ink, the octopus can Dash as a bonus action.
sections.Encounter notes: The Octopus Den contains three albino specimens if an eligible rank 2 Lords’ Alliance member is present. They attack in a group if the coin is disturbed, each targeting one character and trying to drag them away.

name: Guard Dog (Wolf)
otherStatistics: AC includes natural armor. Perception +3. Stealth +4. Passive Perception 13. No languages or special senses.
appearance: A wolf-like guard dog with a thick gray-brown coat, upright ears, and a long muzzle.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast D&D Adventurers League, Cole Kronewitter, The Waydown, November 1, 2015 release, Appendix: Monster/NPC Statistics, printed and p. 26. https://www.dmsguild.com/product/170504/DDEX309-The-Waydown-5e
sections.Traits:
Keen Hearing and Smell. The guard dog has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on hearing or smell.

Pack Tactics. The guard dog has advantage when attacking a creature within 5 ft. of one of its allies, provided that ally is not incapacitated.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 7 (2d4 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 11 Strength save or fall prone.
sections.Encounter notes: Eight guard dogs sleep in a cage. If roused, they bark and howl and draw two nearby Red Plume sergeants after five rounds. The Red Plumes also include a guard dog in each patrol.

name: Giant Poisonous Snake
otherStatistics: AC includes natural armor. Perception +2. Blindsight 10 ft. Passive Perception 12. No languages.
appearance: A coiled olive-brown snake with dark blotches, a pale underside, and a narrow tapering tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast D&D Adventurers League, Ash Law, The Donjon, version 1.0, ©2016, Appendix: Monster/NPC Statistics, printed and p. 33. https://www.dmsguild.com/product/184344/DDAL0411-The-Donjon-5e
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. A hit deals 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage. The target makes a DC 11 Constitution save, taking 10 (3d6) poison damage on a failure or half as much on a success.
sections.Encounter notes: The Rat-Bone Corridor contains 4d4 giant poisonous snakes. The separate swamp encounter entry uses 2d4 − 1.

name: Giant Spider
otherStatistics: AC includes natural armor. Stealth +7. Blindsight 10 ft. Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 10. No languages.
appearance: A long-legged brown spider with a round abdomen and pale chevrons.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast D&D Adventurers League, Ash Law, The Donjon, version 1.0, ©2016, Appendix: Monster/NPC Statistics, printed and p. 33. https://www.dmsguild.com/product/184344/DDAL0411-The-Donjon-5e
sections.Traits:
Spider Climb. The spider can climb difficult surfaces and move upside down on ceilings without an ability check.

Web Sense. While touching a web, it knows the exact location of any other creature touching that web.

Web Walker. Webbing does not restrict the spider’s movement.
sections.Actions:
Bite. Melee weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. A hit deals 7 (1d8 + 3) piercing damage. The creature makes a DC 11 Constitution save, taking 9 (2d8) poison damage on a failure or half as much on a success. If this poison damage reduces it to 0 HP, it remains stable and is poisoned for 1 hour even if it regains HP. It is paralyzed while poisoned this way.

Web (Recharge 5–6). Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 30/60 ft., one creature. The webbing restrains the target on a hit. The restrained target can take an action and succeed on a DC 12 Strength check to break it. The web can also be attacked and destroyed. It has AC 10, 5 HP, vulnerability to fire damage, and immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage.
sections.Encounter notes: The ceiling hatches in area H were once stocked with live giant spiders. They now drop dead, mold-covered specimens.

name: Giant Rat
otherStatistics: Darkvision 60 ft. Passive Perception 10. No languages.
appearance: An oversized brown rat with thick fur, fine whiskers, and a long bare tail.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast D&D Adventurers League, Ash Law, No Foolish Matter, October 1, 2015 release, Appendix: Monster/NPC Statistics, printed and p. 18. https://www.dmsguild.com/product/170499/DDEX306-No-Foolish-Matter-5e
sections.Traits:
Keen Smell. The rat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on smell.

Pack Tactics. The rat has advantage when attacking a creature within 5 ft. of one of its allies, provided that ally is not incapacitated.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. A hit deals 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.
sections.Encounter notes: Two giant rats attack alongside the carnival thugs and rat swarms.
